parameters.content:
## Generate ultra-realistic shorts with Veo 3.1 on Pollo API


### Overview
Automate the creation of ultra-realistic AI video shorts using [Pollo API](https://api.pollo.ai)'s [Veo 3.1 API](https://docs.pollo.ai/m/google/veo3-1) through this intuitive n8n workflow. Veo 3.1 is especially suited for cinematic short-form clips that need natural motion, believable camera direction, synced audio, and tighter visual guidance from prompts or reference images.


**Key Benefits:**
- 🎥 Ultra-realistic motion, lighting, and scene detail for camera-like short-form clips.
- 🖼️ Up to 3 reference images for tighter subject, style, and visual direction.
- 🎧 Improved audio-visual synchronization with dialogue, ambience, and sound effects.
- 🎬 Advanced frame-to-frame control for more coherent cinematic progression.


### Perfect for
Short-form creators, social media teams, ad producers, e-commerce brands, creative agencies, and automation builders that need realistic video clips with controlled visuals and synced audio.


### Prerequisites
- [Pollo API account](https://api.pollo.ai) and API key ([Get your API key here](https://api.pollo.ai/api-keys)).
- Active n8n instance with form submission capabilities.
- AI prompts and optional source or reference image URLs for video generation.


### Quick Setup


#### 1. **Get API Key**
Register at [api.pollo.ai](https://api.pollo.ai) and generate your API key.


#### 2. **Configure Form Fields**
Set up these fields in your "On Form Submission" node:
- **`prompt`** (Required): Detailed text description of the video short you want to generate.
- **`image_url`** (Optional): Source or reference image URLs for guided video generation (up to 3 images, separate multiple URLs with commas); leave blank for text-to-video.
- **`model_path`** (Required): Enter `google/veo3-1` to route the request to the Veo 3.1 model.
- **`api_key`** (Required): Your Pollo AI API key for authentication.


#### 3. **Test & Use**
- Execute the workflow.
- Access the generated form URL.
- Fill in your details and submit.
- Wait for processing.
- Results will be displayed automatically.


### Usage Tips


**Reference-First Realism:**
Use reference images when the clip needs a specific product, character, outfit, setting, or visual style. For stronger direction, make each reference image clear, well-lit, and focused on one visual role.


**Better Prompts:**
Describe the subject, setting, camera movement, lighting, physical action, emotional tone, and audio cues so Veo 3.1 can shape the clip like a short cinematic scene.


**Example:** "Ultra-realistic handheld shot of a fashion model walking through a rainy Tokyo street at night, neon reflections on wet pavement, soft cinematic lighting, subtle ambient street noise, confident slow-motion movement, luxury editorial mood."


**Common Uses:**
- Realistic social media video shorts
- Cinematic product teaser clips
- UGC-style ad variations
- Fashion and lifestyle motion concepts
- Reference-guided brand visuals
- Short narrative scene drafts


### Troubleshooting
- **API Key Invalid**: Ensure your API key is correct and active.
- **Generation Fails**: Check whether your source or reference image URLs are publicly accessible and not behind a login. Also, make sure your prompt follows safety guidelines.


**Keywords:** Veo 3.1 API, Pollo API, multi-image video generation, Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, automated video ads, e-commerce video,  reference-to-video, native audio sync, n8n template, AI video workflow

## Capture and submit prompt

Starts the workflow from a form submission and sends the entered prompt and generation settings to the Pollo video generation API.

## Poll generation status

Waits for Pollo to process the video, queries the task status, and loops back to wait again until the generation is complete.

## Display generated video

Formats the completed generation response for output, including task ID, status, video URL, and media type.
